_meta.what: V5 measurement-quality audit: per-language parallel series for each channel, fetched with GDELT sourcelang operators on the identical frozen dictionaries. Purpose is measuring the English-language bias of the index, published as a divergence number per channel. Languages registered with rationale BEFORE the first full fetch; additions append-only with a dated reason. Three languages at v1.0.0 keeps the first fetch to about 30 full-range requests; the roster grows once the pattern is proven.
_meta.construct_note: Each language series is a share of that language's monitored corpus and ranks against its own trailing 730 days, so cross-language comparison is rank-vs-rank, never raw-share-vs-raw-share (corpus sizes differ by orders of magnitude).

hin.label: Hindi
hin.rationale: largest Indian-language press corpus; the domestic-attention baseline English coverage should be audited against

urd.label: Urdu
urd.rationale: the language of Pakistan's press and part of India's own; the Pakistan channel's most important non-English mirror

zho.label: Chinese
zho.rationale: the strategic counterparty's press; china_east salience measured in the other side's language is the sharpest bias probe available
